name: NY Ori

paper.title: The environment around young eruptive stars. SPHERE/IRDIS polarimetric imaging of 7 protostars

notes: EXor object in the Orion Nebula Cloud complex; SPHERE polarimetry reveals a faint, marginally resolved disk (Zurlo et al. 2024). Visually close (5.5 arcsec) to the unrelated star V566 Ori (Parenago 2118). The paper uses the Q_phi image for this target (single, faint central light source) rather than PI.
